about_the_game:
Expansion pack #3 is for all the Support lovers out there, and everyone loves Support! That's because it's such a versatile resource: it can be used to power Pipeline Network engines, or deliver 10 Attack out of nowhere with 5 brand new Infantry drafts.

Speaking of versatility, this pack also features 2 cards with a new card type combo: Action/Unit, giving you last minute strategic control.

Doubling Down on Support

Warning: this card will give you more Support than you'll know what to do with... oh wait, I think this is just lethal.

Action/Unit

2 spare Support? Destroyer has you covered. Got a Freight Ship in need of Support? Destroyer has you covered. Not sure if you want to keep building or start attacking? Why not both?? When you have a Destroyer in hand, you can either play it as an Action for a Support and a draw, or keep it in your hand as a Unit that can be supported twice.

Mobile Lab

Finally, I want to introduce you to my favorite card in the whole game. It's a Tier 1 card that lets you draw 2 cards, what's the catch?
